Overview

Logroño is a city in La Rioja with a population of 152,000. The capital of La Rioja wine region, famous for its Calle Laurel tapas bars, excellent wines, and a lively culinary scene. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6a growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
